description: This file defines the ContentTranslationController class for managing entity translation operations in Drupal, including preparing translations, viewing translation overviews, and adding/editing translations.

classes.name: ContentTranslationController
classes.description: Controller class for managing content translation operations such as preparing translations, viewing translation overviews, and adding/editing translations within Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ContentTranslationController with translation manager, entity field manager, and time services.

methods.name: prepareTranslation
methods.description: Prepares and populates translation data for a given entity from source to target language.

methods.name: overview
methods.description: Builds and returns the translations overview page for a specific entity, showing translation statuses and operations.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Builds the form for adding a new translation to an entity in a specified language.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Builds the form for editing an existing translation of an entity in a specified language.
